source_artifacts.teaching_use: The user-selected target report form; preserved only as a result-known teacher snapshot.
Accepted economic-content review of the rebuilt judgment and model boundaries.
Independent reconstruction of business engines, owner cash, capital propagation and remaining data limits.
Independent investor-thesis review of growth proof, cash accessibility, value routes and price identity.
Independent acceptance of nearby source binding after the limited writing repair.
Before-to-after trace for the material action-price identity correction.
Before-to-after trace for nearby evidence binding without model mutation.
Accepted user comparison that preserves the newer action hierarchy, restores the older derivation density, and treats zero cash recognition as a lower bound rather than a final estimate.
Principle source only; each principle is bounded by object, mechanism, evidence, misuse and countercondition.

correction_events.before_error_pattern: Project wins, managed-area growth and implementation progress were allowed to stand in for mature project return and owner cash.
correction_events.responsibility_boundary: project acquisition and delivery versus mature cohort profit, collection and capital return
correction_events.error_mechanism: Implementation evidence was promoted through the customer, unit-economics and cash stages without responsibility-matched observations.
correction_events.economic_impact: Unproved growth could inflate normal earnings, owner cash and terminal value while hiding working-capital absorption.
prohibited_assumptions: A contract win proves a mature margin.
Revenue growth proves project-level cash return.
A peer margin can replace target-company cohort economics.

correction.best_current_judgment: New city and project businesses demonstrate acquisition and delivery ability, but remain conditional until mature cohort margin, collection, renewal and cumulative cash are observed.
required_company_evidence: direct labor, subcontracting and start-up capital
acceptance, receivable ageing and cumulative collection
mature project profit and incremental return
correction.investor_consequence: Exclude the unproved growth contribution from base owner cash and preserve it as a conditional component with promotion tests.
correction.uncertainty_treatment: Use a bounded scenario rather than either zero value or full mature economics.
correction.countercondition: A business with immediate prepaid cash, negligible start-up capital and contractually fixed economics may require a shorter proof chain.
correction.reversal_observation: Several mature cohorts show stable renewal, adequate collection and positive cumulative return after all capital absorption.

transfer.portable_rule: Implementation proves implementation only; promote growth into base owner economics after customer adoption, unit economics and cash absorption close on the same responsibility unit.
transfer.applicable_when: A company reports new projects, stores, capacity, acquisitions, products or service cohorts whose mature economics are not separately observable.
transfer.not_applicable_when: The new activity has contractually fixed economics, immediate customer payment and immaterial incremental capital, with direct issuer evidence for each condition.
transfer.next_case_probe: Reconstruct one mature cohort from customer acceptance through unit economics, working capital and cumulative cash before underwriting the portfolio.

correction_events.before_error_pattern: Consolidated cash was at risk of being treated as fully attributable, upstreamable and distributable to ordinary shareholders.
correction_events.responsibility_boundary: consolidated group cash versus legal-entity ownership, restrictions, non-controlling interests and upstream distribution
correction_events.error_mechanism: A balance-sheet amount crossed legal-entity and claim boundaries without a distribution bridge.
correction_events.economic_impact: Downside protection and owner value could be overstated, while a genuine but uncertain cash option could also be incorrectly erased.
prohibited_assumptions: Every unit of consolidated cash is immediately distributable.
Small non-controlling profit proves full cash ownership.
Missing upstream detail means the cash has zero value.

correction.best_current_judgment: Separate consolidated cash, listed-parent cash, restrictions and ordinary-shareholder realization; use the evidenced accessible amount as the base lower bound and preserve the unresolved remainder as a conditional range rather than either an arbitrary percentage or permanent zero.
required_company_evidence: restricted cash, reserves and tax friction
historical upstream distributions, dividends and cancellations
funding source and post-payment balance for special shareholder returns
project-batch collections reconciled without double counting ordinary distributions
correction.investor_consequence: Use a cash-accessibility range, identify its evidenced lower bound, and do not add parent-only, consolidated, project-receipt or already-distributed cash twice.
correction.uncertainty_treatment: Keep exact accessibility unknown while bounding the economic realization range; zero recognition is a current base lower bound only when no positive accessible amount is evidenced.
correction.countercondition: A simple wholly owned structure with unrestricted cash and repeated distributions may justify near-full recognition.
correction.reversal_observation: Entity-level disclosures and repeated distributions demonstrate that ordinary shareholders can realize the cash without material leakage.

transfer.portable_rule: Balance-sheet cash becomes ordinary-shareholder value only through a responsibility-matched ownership and realization bridge; uncertainty narrows recognition but does not automatically make the cash worthless.
transfer.applicable_when: Material cash sits in subsidiaries, regulated entities, joint structures or groups with related-party balances and distribution frictions.
transfer.not_applicable_when: The cash is held directly by the listed parent, unrestricted, wholly attributable and repeatedly distributed or deployed at observable adequate returns.
transfer.next_case_probe: Map cash-holding entities, ownership, restrictions, taxes, upstream history, special-return funding, post-payment balances and project-batch collections; reconcile each source against ordinary distributions before assigning a cash range.

correction_events.before_error_pattern: A parent or ecosystem relationship was narrated as a one-way source of projects, brand and credit support.
correction_events.responsibility_boundary: operating support versus related-party claims, receivables, capital allocation and cash realization
correction_events.error_mechanism: Operating resource provision was netted against cash extraction and governance constraints instead of underwriting both channels separately.
correction_events.economic_impact: The thesis could overstate growth quality and cash protection or, in the opposite direction, ignore real customer and credit advantages.
prohibited_assumptions: Related revenue is automatically high-quality owner value.
Parent support offsets receivable ageing or poor capital allocation.
A related-party relationship is automatically harmful.

correction.best_current_judgment: Underwrite the parent as two concurrent mechanisms: operating support and ordinary-shareholder extraction or constraint.
correction.investor_consequence: Do not capitalize parent support until its net effect on unit economics, cash conversion and minority realization is supportable.
correction.uncertainty_treatment: Keep support and extraction as separate thesis legs with distinct reversal evidence.
correction.countercondition: A legally protected pass-through or arm's-length contract with short settlement can reduce, but not eliminate, the need for cash and governance checks.
correction.reversal_observation: Related operating benefits persist while collection, allocation and shareholder distribution remain economically fair.

transfer.portable_rule: A parent system can improve customer access and financing while simultaneously constraining ordinary-shareholder cash; never net the two mechanisms before tracing each to owner economics.
transfer.applicable_when: The issuer depends materially on a parent, platform, government network, franchise system or related customer group.
transfer.not_applicable_when: Transactions are immaterial and the target has independent customers, financing, allocation and cash distribution.
transfer.next_case_probe: Build two arrows from the relationship: one to operating advantage and one to cash or governance claims, then test both with separate evidence.

correction_events.before_error_pattern: A company-level multi-year incremental return proxy was at risk of being labelled as the permanent return of a particular growth cohort.
correction_events.responsibility_boundary: whole-company change versus project, product or cohort capital and earnings
correction_events.error_mechanism: A conservative aggregate observation was promoted into a causal component parameter without matched numerator, denominator and period.
correction_events.economic_impact: A growth component could be either falsely condemned or falsely valued, changing normal earnings, retained-capital value and price treatment.
prohibited_assumptions: An aggregate proxy identifies a project return.
A short window is a permanent return.
A peer margin can repair a responsibility mismatch.

correction.best_current_judgment: Use the aggregate proxy only as a conservative whole-company observation and keep component return conditional until matched cohort evidence exists.
correction.investor_consequence: Do not use the proxy as a permanent component return or as precise growth value.
correction.uncertainty_treatment: Bound the component and show whether the residual can change the overall thesis.
correction.countercondition: A genuinely single-engine company with stable definitions and immaterial portfolio change may make the aggregate proxy economically close to the component.
correction.reversal_observation: Matched component disclosures reconcile the proxy to mature cohort return over a sufficient window.

transfer.portable_rule: A proxy inherits the responsibility unit, period and numerator-denominator definition from which it was calculated; never promote it to a narrower cohort without reconciliation.
transfer.applicable_when: Only aggregate changes are disclosed while the thesis depends on a particular project, product, acquisition or segment return.
transfer.not_applicable_when: The enterprise is economically single-engine and the disclosed capital and earnings map directly to the claimed unit across a mature period.
transfer.next_case_probe: State the proxy's exact responsibility boundary and ask whether a different component or period could produce the same aggregate result.

correction_events.before_error_pattern: A correctly calculated reverse price under a fixed future market terminal was first treated as self-authorizing, then the correction overreached by leaving the primary action price unknown despite an available best-current business-value route.
correction_events.responsibility_boundary: operating value and cash receipt versus future market realization
correction_events.error_mechanism: The model oscillated between false certainty and route paralysis instead of choosing an explicit best-current economic terminal, exposing its assumptions, and preserving rival routes separately.
correction_events.economic_impact: An investor could either act on an exact number whose decisive return source is unproved or receive no usable research price even though a bounded route judgment is possible.
prohibited_assumptions: A correct reverse calculation is automatically an action price.
A model-derived terminal is equivalent to a contractual receipt.
Different route prices can be averaged into a more reliable number.
Any unproved terminal assumption requires the primary research price to remain unknown.

correction.best_current_judgment: Choose the most defensible current economic terminal as the base route, state why it is preferred, publish the route-bound research price, and show pressure and conditional-confirmation rivals without presenting any route as contractual certainty.
required_company_evidence: consistent treatment of entry and exit assumptions
correction.investor_consequence: Use an explicit research price only inside its named route and required return; do not buy merely because the reverse calculation is precise or hide a supportable action judgment behind a global unknown.
correction.uncertainty_treatment: Preserve base, pressure and conditional-confirmation routes separately, disclose the terminal dependency, and do not average them.
correction.countercondition: If no economically defensible terminal or owner-cash route exists, the action price may remain unknown; a contractual tender, liquidation distribution or repeatable operating cash route can justify stronger identity.
correction.reversal_observation: New operating, distribution, contractual or market-structure evidence makes a rival terminal route more defensible than the selected base route.

transfer.portable_rule: Arithmetic does not authorize a price, but uncertainty does not excuse route paralysis: select the best-current economic terminal, bind the research price to that route, and expose rival terminals and reversal evidence separately.
transfer.applicable_when: A valuation depends materially on future market recognition, a chosen terminal multiple, a catalyst or an uncertain distribution route.
transfer.not_applicable_when: The receipt is contractually fixed or liquidation-bound and needs no competing terminal judgment; if no economically defensible route can be bounded, do not invent one and keep the action price unknown.
transfer.next_case_probe: For every quoted price, name the operating cash, shareholder receipt, terminal mechanism, required return and strongest rival route; explain why the selected base route is currently better.

correction_events.before_error_pattern: A clearer value, terminal, return and action-price hierarchy moved the decision forward but compressed the operating-profit bridge, cash-realization logic and sensitivity attribution into model artifacts.
correction_events.responsibility_boundary: deterministic model computation versus reader-facing economic explanation
correction_events.error_mechanism: The report preserved conclusions and major facts while removing the component bridges that let an investor challenge normalization, cash and route assumptions.
correction_events.economic_impact: A more executable action could still be weakly understood, making the selected value route appear arbitrary and hiding which operating or cash assumption controls the result.
prohibited_assumptions: A correct model output is self-explanatory.
A clearer action table can replace the operating-profit and owner-cash bridge.
Sensitivity without contribution attribution tells the investor what changed the conclusion.

correction.best_current_judgment: Keep the explicit value, terminal, return and action hierarchy while restoring a concise component bridge from business engines through normal earnings and accessible cash to value, plus material sensitivity attribution.
required_company_evidence: component-level normal-earnings bridge with responsibility boundaries
material sensitivity contribution and interaction explanation
reconciliation from operating and cash components to terminal, return and action price
correction.investor_consequence: The reader can act on the selected route and independently challenge the few business, cash and terminal assumptions capable of changing it.
correction.uncertainty_treatment: Keep uncertain components as ranges or conditional bridges and show their maximum route effect; do not hide them in an appendix or fill them with precision.
correction.countercondition: A genuinely single-engine company with immaterial cash and component differences may use a compact local bridge if every material assumption and route reconciliation remains visible.
correction.reversal_observation: An independent reader can reconstruct the material operating-to-value path and identify which component or interaction changes the action treatment without opening hidden model files.

transfer.portable_rule: An executable action hierarchy and a challengeable economic derivation are both required: keep a concise bridge from business components through normal earnings and accessible cash to value, return and action price.
transfer.applicable_when: A report combines several business engines, normalization adjustments, cash-accessibility judgments, sensitivities or competing value routes.
transfer.not_applicable_when: A compact single-engine bridge already exposes every material operating, cash, terminal and return assumption in the reader-facing report.
transfer.next_case_probe: Ask a blind investor to reconstruct the material profit and cash bridge, identify the dominant sensitivity contribution, and reconcile the selected terminal to the action price without opening model artifacts.

correction_events.before_error_pattern: Missing project-level or legal-entity detail risked turning the whole company into an undifferentiated unknown.
correction_events.responsibility_boundary: unresolved component versus independently evidenced mature enterprise components
correction_events.error_mechanism: A missing field propagated beyond the claim and component that depended on it.
correction_events.economic_impact: The report could discard useful normal-earnings and permanent-loss judgments, or hide the unresolved component inside a false precise total.
prohibited_assumptions: One material unknown makes every company judgment unknowable.
A bounded residual can be silently filled with a point estimate.
Exclusion from the base case means zero value or certain failure.

correction.best_current_judgment: Keep mature, independently evidenced engines underwritten; localize the unresolved project or cash-access component and test whether its bounded residual can change the thesis.
correction.investor_consequence: Continue the enterprise judgment while withholding unsupported growth, cash or valuation contributions.
correction.uncertainty_treatment: Use component-level conditional or scenario treatment with a whole-company materiality check.
correction.countercondition: If the unresolved component dominates survival, financing or the value route, it can legitimately constrain the whole-case treatment.
correction.reversal_observation: The missing component becomes measurable or its bounded downside is shown to dominate the enterprise.

transfer.portable_rule: Propagate an unknown only through the claims and components that depend on it; retain independent enterprise economics unless the residual can dominate survival, owner cash or value.
transfer.applicable_when: A diversified or multi-engine company has one material but separable evidence gap.
transfer.not_applicable_when: The missing item controls solvency, financing continuity, the dominant earnings engine or the only credible realization route.
transfer.next_case_probe: Draw the unknown's dependency path and bound its maximum effect before deciding whether it is local or whole-company.

correction_events.before_error_pattern: Low bankruptcy risk and continued dividends could be mistaken for low permanent-loss risk.
correction_events.responsibility_boundary: enterprise survival versus ordinary-share value per unit of retained capital
correction_events.error_mechanism: Solvency protection was allowed to override margin erosion, low-return reinvestment, cash inaccessibility and related allocation.
correction_events.economic_impact: A stable-looking company could slowly destroy per-share value while the report understates downside and overstates the benefit of waiting.
prohibited_assumptions: Low bankruptcy probability means low permanent loss.
Any dividend proves retained capital creates value.
Accounting cash accumulation protects ordinary shareholders regardless of accessibility.

correction.best_current_judgment: Assess permanent loss through erosion of mature economics, cash absorption, low-return retention and shareholder realization, not only through insolvency.
correction.investor_consequence: Demand a larger value discount or withhold action when survival is strong but per-share value creation is unproved.
correction.uncertainty_treatment: Model slow erosion and opportunity-cost paths separately from bankruptcy.
correction.countercondition: A shrinking business that liquidates assets and distributes proceeds can preserve owner value despite weak operating growth.
correction.reversal_observation: Mature earnings stabilize and retained capital repeatedly converts into adequate per-share cash or value.

transfer.portable_rule: Permanent loss includes slow per-share value destruction through margin erosion, cash absorption and low-return retention even when solvency and dividends remain intact.
transfer.applicable_when: A mature, cash-rich or state-linked company appears financially safe but retains material capital or expands into weaker economics.
transfer.not_applicable_when: The company is executing a credible liquidation or distribution path that returns capital despite operating contraction.
transfer.next_case_probe: Separate survival from per-share owner value, then trace every retained unit into incremental return, accessible cash or irreversible loss.

correction_events.before_error_pattern: The report had enough evidence and a closed model, but decisive cash, growth and permanent-loss claims were not bound to nearby primary-source locations.
correction_events.responsibility_boundary: observed fact versus economic inference versus deterministic model output
correction_events.error_mechanism: A remote source table left the reader unable to tell which material premise was observed and which was inferred.
correction_events.economic_impact: A conditional price or group narrative could be mistaken for a disclosed fact, weakening the user's ability to audit the conclusion without changing the model itself.
prohibited_assumptions: A bibliography at the end binds every material claim.
A model output can replace evidence for its economic premise.
A writing-only repair authorizes changes to operating inputs or price identity.

correction.best_current_judgment: Place concise primary-source anchors beside decisive observed facts while keeping inference and model output visibly separate.
required_company_evidence: primary-source page or section for material premises
nearby wording that identifies inference and uncertainty
correction.investor_consequence: The reader can verify the thesis without treating a condition, scenario or calculation as issuer evidence.
correction.uncertainty_treatment: Repair source propagation only; do not mutate accepted economics to satisfy a presentation issue.
correction.countercondition: A compact table can bind several adjacent claims when the mapping from each fact to its source remains unambiguous.
correction.reversal_observation: An independent reader can trace every decisive premise to the cited primary source and distinguish it from inference and model output.

transfer.portable_rule: Bind primary evidence beside each decisive factual premise and keep inference and model output in separate language; a writing repair must not silently change economics.
transfer.applicable_when: A report relies on cash accessibility, cohort economics, related-party transmission, permanent loss or route identity that a reader could otherwise mistake for disclosed fact.
transfer.not_applicable_when: A compact local table already maps each decisive premise unambiguously to a primary source and clearly labels inference and calculation.
transfer.next_case_probe: Ask a blind reader to trace the central thesis, strongest rival, owner cash, permanent loss and route premise directly to nearby primary evidence.

conditional_principles.title: Separate current earning power from growth value
conditional_principles.principle_statement: Value current assets and earning power separately from growth; growth enters only when incremental economics and owner realization are supportable.
conditional_principles.economic_object: asset value, earning-power value and growth value
conditional_principles.applicable_when: A thesis combines mature operations, excess assets and new growth components.
conditional_principles.mechanism: Mature earnings, distributable assets and reinvested capital reach owners through different cash and competitive mechanisms and therefore require separate evidence and routes.
conditional_principles.common_misuse: Adding cash, current earnings and an assumed growth premium into one blended value without checking overlap or realization.
counterconditions: A liquidation case may make asset realization primary and ongoing earnings secondary.
A young single-engine company may lack mature earning power and require a bounded option treatment rather than a false three-part precision.
conditional_principles.downstream_use: Assign each component to base, conditional, stress or excluded valuation routes without averaging incompatible price identities.
conditional_principles.disconfirming_observation: The supposedly separate components are economically inseparable or double count the same cash flow.

conditional_principles.title: Retained capital is valuable only through incremental owner economics
conditional_principles.principle_statement: Retained earnings are not automatically worth their accounting amount; their value depends on incremental return, cash conversion and ordinary-shareholder realization.
conditional_principles.applicable_when: A company retains material owner earnings, expands capacity, acquires businesses or builds new service cohorts.
conditional_principles.mechanism: Retention creates per-share value only when the resulting earnings and accessible cash exceed the relevant capital requirement after all absorption.
conditional_principles.common_misuse: Treating every retained unit as additional value or using revenue growth as proof of adequate incremental return.
counterconditions: Temporary defensive liquidity can preserve survival value without generating a normal growth return.
A regulated utility can require a rate-base and allowed-return analysis instead of a generic cohort test.
conditional_principles.downstream_use: Exclude unproved retention from base growth value, reflect current total capital absorption in financing pressure and specify promotion tests.
conditional_principles.disconfirming_observation: Mature investments repeatedly earn and distribute adequate incremental owner cash on matched capital.

conditional_principles.title: Cash value follows the shareholder claim and realization path
conditional_principles.principle_statement: Cash protects ordinary shareholders only to the extent that ownership, restrictions, allocation and distribution make it economically accessible.
conditional_principles.applicable_when: Material cash is held across subsidiaries, financial units, joint structures or related-party networks.
conditional_principles.mechanism: Legal-entity ownership, reserves, regulation, taxes, non-controlling claims, receivables and capital allocation determine whether consolidated cash becomes ordinary-shareholder value.
target_company_evidence: project-batch collections reconciled to ordinary distributions
conditional_principles.common_misuse: Counting all consolidated cash at full value, counting parent and consolidated cash twice, or assigning zero because exact upstreamability is missing.
counterconditions: Direct unrestricted parent cash with repeated distribution can justify high recognition.
Regulated or deposit-funded financial cash requires its own capital and liquidity boundary rather than an industrial cash formula.
conditional_principles.downstream_use: Use a cash-accessibility range in owner cash, permanent loss and value routes without allowing the range to become a legal-entitlement claim.
conditional_principles.disconfirming_observation: Actual entity disclosures or repeated distributions establish a materially different accessibility boundary.

conditional_principles.title: Price identity follows the economic route
conditional_principles.principle_statement: A price is meaningful only after identifying the owner-cash, asset-realization or market-terminal route that can deliver it.
conditional_principles.economic_object: valuation route and margin of safety
conditional_principles.applicable_when: Several reverse prices, value routes or terminal assumptions coexist.
conditional_principles.mechanism: Different routes answer different questions and bear different realization risks; numerical precision cannot reconcile incompatible mechanisms.
conditional_principles.common_misuse: Averaging route prices, promoting a fixed-terminal reverse calculation to action status, or confusing a stress boundary with a base value.
counterconditions: A contractually fixed receipt can make a reverse price directly executable within its terms.
A liquidation route can supersede operating EPV when the asset-distribution mechanism is actually underway.
conditional_principles.downstream_use: Keep route-specific prices separate, choose the best-current defensible route for the explicit research price, and leave the action price unresolved only when no route can be economically bounded.
conditional_principles.disconfirming_observation: New evidence makes a rival route more defensible or shows that no route can support an explicit research price.

conditional_principles.title: Permanent loss includes slow per-share value destruction
conditional_principles.principle_statement: Permanent loss is the impairment of owner purchasing power and per-share value, not merely insolvency or price volatility.
conditional_principles.applicable_when: A financially stable company retains capital, faces mature-margin pressure or expands into weaker economics.
conditional_principles.mechanism: Low-return retention, inaccessible cash, working-capital absorption and competitive erosion can destroy owner value while the enterprise survives.
conditional_principles.common_misuse: Equating survival, cash balance or continued dividends with low permanent-loss risk.
counterconditions: A credible liquidation and distribution plan can preserve owner value during operating decline.
Temporary countercyclical retention can protect earning power if later release and returns are observable.
conditional_principles.downstream_use: Include slow erosion and opportunity-cost paths in downside treatment and required margin of safety.
conditional_principles.disconfirming_observation: Retained capital repeatedly converts into adequate per-share owner cash or durable earning power.

conditional_principles.title: Industry structure bounds management quality
conditional_principles.principle_statement: Management skill matters through the strategic and capital-allocation choices available inside an industry's customer, competition and profit-pool structure.
conditional_principles.applicable_when: The thesis credits management, a parent platform or execution with overcoming price, customer or competitive pressure.
conditional_principles.mechanism: Strong execution can improve position and allocation, but cannot by itself repeal weak bargaining power, poor unit economics or structural capital absorption.
conditional_principles.common_misuse: Using biographies, awards, project wins or parent reputation as direct evidence of durable economics.
counterconditions: A demonstrable business-model change can alter the company's exposure to the old industry structure.
A legally protected franchise can make regulation rather than conventional competition the decisive bound.
conditional_principles.downstream_use: Make industry and management judgments meet in company-specific normal earnings, owner cash and reversal conditions.
conditional_principles.disconfirming_observation: The company sustains superior unit economics and cash through an adverse competitive period on a responsibility-matched basis.

conditional_principles.title: Localize uncertainty and keep the reader able to verify the thesis
conditional_principles.principle_statement: A material unknown limits the claim that depends on it; the report must still make the remaining enterprise judgment and bind decisive facts near that judgment.
conditional_principles.applicable_when: One component lacks exact economics or cash attribution while other enterprise mechanisms remain independently supportable.
conditional_principles.mechanism: Component boundaries prevent unsupported propagation, while nearby evidence lets the reader distinguish observation, inference and model output.
target_company_evidence: dependency path from unknown to decision
clearly labelled inference and model output
conditional_principles.common_misuse: Ending the whole case as unknown, filling the gap with precision, or hiding all sources in a remote bibliography.
counterconditions: A missing solvency, financing or dominant-engine fact can legitimately block the whole treatment.
A concise local source table is sufficient when each claim-to-source mapping is unambiguous.
conditional_principles.downstream_use: Continue normal earnings, owner cash, permanent loss and value judgments that remain independent; downgrade only the affected route and state the reversal evidence.
conditional_principles.disconfirming_observation: The residual can dominate the whole enterprise or the cited source fails to support the decisive premise.

cutoff_feedback_design.target_identity_rule: Apply only to a different company or a later cutoff that was not used to author this teacher package; the target must remain outcome-sealed during judgment.
cutoff_feedback_design.outcome_source_policy: Predeclare responsibility-matched official result sources and open each clock only after the frozen date; the teacher report and training memory are never outcome sources.
forbidden_outcome_proxies: retrospective management explanation without the frozen operating measure
a later acquisition, survival or narrative that does not settle the predeclared claim

feedback_clocks.diagnostic_observation: Customer adoption, utilization or renewal and unit economics are observed on the same new component after implementation.
feedback_clocks.supports_rule: The frozen treatment kept implementation separate and correctly promoted or withheld the component using customer and unit-economics evidence.
feedback_clocks.refutes_rule: The frozen treatment either capitalized implementation alone or excluded a mature observable component despite matched customer and unit-economics evidence.
feedback_clocks.mixed_rule: Implementation or customer adoption improves while mature unit economics remain unavailable or responsibility-mismatched.

feedback_clocks.diagnostic_observation: Operating cash, maintenance needs, growth capital, working-capital absorption and shareholder accessibility are reconciled on the frozen responsibility units.
feedback_clocks.supports_rule: The frozen owner-cash range and component roles anticipated the observed capital and accessibility pattern without using teacher facts as evidence.
feedback_clocks.refutes_rule: The frozen treatment omitted a material cash absorber or withheld an evidenced accessible cash engine for an inapplicable teacher analogy.
feedback_clocks.mixed_rule: Cash direction is observable but maintenance, growth, ownership or timing definitions do not match the frozen claim.

feedback_clocks.diagnostic_observation: Mature economics, incremental return, distributions and any claimed realization route persist long enough to test per-share value creation rather than enterprise survival alone.
feedback_clocks.supports_rule: The frozen permanent-loss and route treatment correctly distinguished survival, per-share value and realization evidence.
feedback_clocks.refutes_rule: The frozen treatment relied on an unsupported terminal or missed a durable owner-value route because the teacher boundary was applied mechanically.
feedback_clocks.mixed_rule: The enterprise survives and distributes some cash, but retained-capital return or route realization remains non-diagnostic.

cutoff_feedback_design.settlement_route: Use the existing append-only judgment feedback and outcome-acquisition controls; do not create a second settlement control plane.
cutoff_feedback_design.learning_route: Only an independently accepted cutoff feedback card may create a judgment-learning note and later cross-company application receipt.

transfer_acceptance.baseline_policy: Give Baseline only the common target cutoff source package and the current judgment-first enterprise contract.
transfer_acceptance.enhanced_policy: Give Enhanced the identical target evidence and budget plus only the compiled expert-correction training memory as TRAINING_MEMORY.
transfer_acceptance.agent_isolation: Run Baseline and Enhanced with separate fork_turns=none fresh agents; neither arm may read parent context, sibling output, teacher source snapshots or sealed outcome.
transfer_acceptance.reviewer_blinding: A third fresh reviewer reads anonymous arms before any outcome access and identifies concrete material decision deltas rather than scoring length or confidence.
transfer_acceptance.pass_rule: Enhanced must avoid at least one material expert correction or produce a materially better treatment on a decisive surface, with no new material fact, reasoning, model, price-identity or evidence-binding error and no evidence-budget advantage.
transfer_acceptance.failure_rule: More prose, more fields, more caveats, more pessimism, an unchanged investment treatment, a clearer action table that hides the material operating-to-value derivation, or a teacher analogy unsupported by target-company evidence is not utility.
transfer_acceptance.report_gate: The first-pass report must have no OPEN MATERIAL finding under golden-report-review-return.v2 and must preserve a reader-reconstructable bridge from business components through normal earnings and accessible cash to value, return and action price; only non-material writing polish may remain before the human acts as final approver.
transfer_acceptance.claim_limit: This teacher package is TRAINING_READY only. One positive unseen result creates a TRANSFER_CANDIDATE; repeated different-company and company-and-time holdouts are required before METHOD_VALIDATED or report autonomy can be claimed.
